opposite party-1.
2.

Even though the names of Mr. Saroj Kumar Tiwari, Mr. Shekhar Gangal and Mr. Shiv Sharan Tripathi are duly published in the cause list as counsel for opposite party, however, neither they nor any one on their behalf has put in appearance to oppose this application.

3. Challenge in this Criminal Misc. Application Under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is to the charge sheet dated 23.06.2019 submitted in Case Crime No. 489 of 2018 under Sections 498A, 307, 323, 327,

sentences.text:
Present application came up for admission on 22.08.2019 and this Court passed the following order:
"Sri Shekhar Gangal, learned Advocate has filed his vakalatnama on behalf of the opposite party no.2, is taken on record.

Heard Sri Gaurav Sharma, learned counsel for the applicants, learned Additional Government Advocate on behalf of the State/opposite party no.1, Sri Shekhar Gangal,
learned counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party no.2 and perused the record with the assistance of learned counsel for the parties.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the applicants with a prayer to quash the impugned charge-sheet dated 23.06.2019 arising out of Case Crime No.0489 of 2018 as well as entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.779 of 2019,
under sections 498A, 307, 323, 327 & 504, 506 I.P.C and Dowry Prohibition Act,
Police Station Gandhi Park, District Aligarh, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-IIIrd, Aligarh.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicants that applicant no.1 Ravi Kant Singh is husband, applicant no.2 Ranveer Singh is father-in-law, applicant no.3 Kusum Lata Singh is mother-in-law & applicant no.4 Shashi Kant is brother-in-law (devar) of opposite party no.2 Smt.Shalu Singh.

entities.text:
Dowry Prohibition Act,
Police Station Gandhi Park, District Aligarh
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Marriage of the applicant no.1 with opposite party no.2 was solemnized on 18.02.2018, but their matrimonial life was not successful, as a result thereof the opposite party no.2 lodged F.I.R. dated 29.09.2018,
under sections 498A, 307, 323, 327, 504, 506 & Dowry Prohibition Act, registered as Case Crime No.0489 of 2018, making several allegations of harassment and torture adopting different modus-operandi against the applicants.

It is submitted that marriage of the applicant no.1 with opposite party no.2 was love marriage, which is also apparent on record from the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C. of the opposite party no.2, therefore, there was no question for demand of dowry.

The opposite party no.2 in her statement under section 161 Cr.P.C. has stated that the applicant no.1 was in her relation and he was living in the house of the opposite party no.2 since last eight years prior to her marriage and both were indulged in free love, therefore, the family members of the applicant no.1 as well as of opposite party no.2 got their marriage solemnized.

It is further submitted that the father of the opposite party no.2 is Sub-Inspector in Police Department, therefore, the investigating officer has not conducted fair investigation in collusion with the opposite party no.2 and her father.

It is next submitted that the opposite party no.2 is a lady of modern ideology,
therefore, she was not interested to discharge her matrimonial obligation towards her husband and other family members.

It is also pointed out that on account of Ravi Kant Singh And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 31 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25761374/
2 influence of father of opposite party no.2, the applicants were compelled to sit at the police station for two days.

entities.text: Ravi Kant Singh And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The F.I.R of the applicants was not lodged by the police,
then the applicant No.2 moved an application dated 10.10.2018 under section 156(3)
Cr.P.C. before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Aligarh, which has been treated as complaint by order dated 28.11.2018 and the case is still pending.
Lastly, it is submitted that the applicants have been falsely implicated in this case by the opposite party no.2 in order to settle her personal score.
The matter requires consideration.
Learned Additional Government Advocate has accepted notice on behalf of opposite party no.1.
Sri Shekhar Gangal, learned Advocate has accepted notice on behalf of opposite party no.2.
All opposite parties may file counter affidavit within a period of four weeks.
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, may be filed by the applicants within two weeks thereafter.
List this case on 11.10.2019 showing the name of Sri Shekhar Gangal, as counsel for the opposite party no.2.

Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants pursuant to chargesheet dated 23.06.2019 arising out of Case Crime No.489 of 2018 in Criminal Case No.779 of 2019, under sections 498A, 307, 323, 327 & 504, 506 I.P.C and Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Gandhi Park, District Aligarh,
pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-IIIrd, Aligarh.

List in the next cause list.

Order Date :- 4.2.2020 "
6.
During the pendency of this application, charges have been framed against applicant vide framing of charge order dated 16.03.2023 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Court No. 13, Aligarh.

3 application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been rendered infructuous due to non-extension of interim order granted earlier on 22.08.2019.

8. As a result, this application fails and is liable to be dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
9. It is accordingly dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
